description: This line plot illustrates the performance of two large language models—GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet—on a task measured by Accuracy@1 (%) as a function of the number of child nodes (tree width) in a multimodal tree search framework. The x-axis, labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width),” is linear and ranges from 1 to 7, with tick marks at integer values 1, 3, 5, and 7. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)”, is linear and spans from 15% to 35%, with major gridlines every 5 percentage points. Two distinct lines are plotted: GPT-4o, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, begins at 24.4% at width 1, rises to 28.9% at width 3, peaks at 34.7% at width 5, and then declines to 31.1% at width 7. Claude-3.5-Sonnet, shown as a solid light purple line with ‘x’ markers, starts at 26.7% at width 1, increases slightly to 27.8% at width 3, then decreases steadily to 24.4% at width 5 and further to 20.0% at width 7. A gray rectangular highlight is placed around the peak value of GPT-4o at width 5. The legend in the top center identifies the two models with their respective line styles and colors.
